baseline_command.test_only_script:
# inet fvpn boot baseline. Member forwarding is off (§8.2).
add table inet fvpn
flush set inet fvpn allowed_v4
delete chain inet fvpn forward
add chain inet fvpn forward { type filter hook forward priority -150; policy drop; }
delete chain inet fvpn input
add chain inet fvpn input { type filter hook input priority -150; policy accept; }
delete chain inet fvpn output
add chain inet fvpn output { type filter hook output priority -150; policy accept; }
delete chain inet fvpn postrouting
add chain inet fvpn postrouting { type nat hook postrouting priority 100; policy accept; }
add rule inet fvpn forward ip saddr 192.0.2.255 ip daddr 192.0.2.255 comment "fvpn_generation=0 fvpn_baseline=1 fvpn_metering=forward_admission_v1"
add rule inet fvpn forward ip saddr 192.0.2.255 ip daddr 192.0.2.255 comment "fvpn_class=019a0000-0000-7000-8000-00000000000a:2f"
add rule inet fvpn forward ip saddr 192.0.2.255 ip daddr 192.0.2.255 comment "fvpn_class=019a0000-0000-7000-8000-00000000000b:30"
add rule inet fvpn forward iifname "fv-fh" counter name "ctbase" drop
add rule inet fvpn forward oifname "fv-fh" counter name "ctbase" drop
add rule inet fvpn forward iifname "fv-fh" meta nfproto ipv6 counter name "ctv6" drop
add rule inet fvpn forward oifname "fv-fh" meta nfproto ipv6 counter name "ctv6" drop
add rule inet fvpn input iifname "fv-fh" counter name "ctin" drop
add rule inet fvpn input ip saddr 100.64.0.0/10 counter name "ctin" drop
